title: Mercado YPFivo Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with Mercado YPFivo? Its page offers cryptocurrencies trading and a $250 minimum but names no regulator or licence.
author: Sophia Reynolds

content:
The page is headed with a verification question without verification. "YPF" appears in the name, but this page has no link to the Argentine company YPF. It offers crypto trading paid by credit card. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: online trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: cryptocurrencies
  • Payment methods: credit cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal usually within a day
  • Registration fee: no sign-up or processing fee
  • Support: all-day support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
